Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely declared the task complete without engaging any specialist, misinterpreted the requirement to choose and coordinate capabilities, and provided an answer that does not match the given options and contradicts the ground truth. Specifically, it claimed orbital revolution was not required and proposed “C) a rod through each ball to allow it to spin/tilt,” which is not one of the provided choices. The correct characteristic to best demonstrate a solar eclipse is the ability to revolve around a central ball (option A).
